verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Jan's desktop app, its model import and Hub download features, and an OpenAI-compatible local API server powered by llama.cpp. None of it documents a command-line interface for loading models, and none mentions GPU offload (e.g., GPU layers) or context-length settings. A CLI with runtime parameters is a fair axis for a local LLM runner, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
